title: Condensation-Prone Window Ranking
dataSources: Mould risk (`mould:risk`), crack meters (`crackmeter:reading`), HVAC filter life (`hvacfilter:life`), structural tilt (`structural:tilt`).
app: Building-health sensors — indoor humidity / mould-risk monitors, crack and tilt meters, HVAC filter-life trackers, and damp sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and ESPHome.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mould:risk window_id=*
| stats min(dewpoint_gap) as worst_gap, avg(humidity_pct) as avg_humidity by window_id
| sort worst_gap
description: Ranks the windows or cold surfaces most likely to attract condensation.
value: Knowing the worst spots helps you prioritise insulation, ventilation, or simple daily wiping where it matters most.
implementation: Attach window or surface identifiers to mould-risk readings; rank surfaces by worst dew-point gap.
visualization: Table of windows ranked by condensation risk.
grandmaExplanation: It maps which windows or cold surfaces are most likely to collect moisture and start trouble.
